notes: Independent re-retrieval with 14 differently worded domain-restricted searches. Search tool returns blended summaries, so attributions to single pages are best-effort; sentences were kept only where the returned text stated them. Removed: alcohol/processed meat risk factors (no named page), over-65 figure, NCI enzyme/malnutrition claim, PMC single-snippet EUS/CT biopsy claims, "some people with no known risk factors", Pancreatic Cancer UK family-history monitoring wording (replaced by CRUK screening statement), MedlinePlus attribution for exam/blood tests. NICE CT sentence narrowed (was overstated as first scan for all suspected cases). Radiotherapy reworded to NHS "not often used". Remaining weaker items for a human glance: chronic pancreatitis association and BRCA2/Lynch (from blended summaries), stent/bypass wording, Royal United Hospital ultrasound sentence. No 999 route stated: sources only give urgent GP/NHS 111 or GP/A&E for jaundice.
